info.title: EduHub Creator Analytics API
info.description: Contract C4. Generated from eduhub_shared; do not edit by hand.

post.summary: Generate drafts in the creator's voice
Test variants with a synthetic audience

AccountKPIs.description: Account-level KPIs. Rates are aggregated as sum(interactions) / sum(impressions).
AccountKPIs.title: AccountKPIs

AccountProfile.description: Public profile of a creator account.
AccountProfile.title: AccountProfile

AnalysisJob.description: Status of an analysis job. report_id is set when status is 'done'; error when 'failed'.

message.description: es-AR label of the current step.
message.title: Message

AnalysisJob.title: AnalysisJob

AnalysisReport.description: Full analysis of an account. This is the AI output contract and the dashboard's data.

posts.description: Every snapshot post exactly once, newest first.
posts.title: Posts

heatmap.description: Only slots with at least one post.
heatmap.title: Heatmap

engine.description: Which analyzer produced it, e.g. 'fake' or 'hybrid-v1'.
engine.title: Engine

context.description: The creator brief the report was made with.

AnalysisReport.title: AnalysisReport

AnalyzedPost.description: A post with its features, rates, relative score and optional explanation.

score.description: Performance vs the account's typical post (1.0 = typical).
score.title: Score

explanation.description: es-AR: why it performed so (at least top/bottom posts).
explanation.title: Explanation

AnalyzedPost.title: AnalyzedPost

ApiError.description: Error details. message is human readable (es-AR) and safe to show in the UI.
ApiError.title: ApiError

AudienceDimension.description: Persona attribute used to break down simulation results.
AudienceDimension.title: AudienceDimension

AudienceFilters.description: Restrict the simulated audience. Empty lists mean no restriction.
AudienceFilters.title: AudienceFilters

CreatorContext.description:
The creator's brief ("el para qué"): goal, offering, audience, voice. Every field is optional, free text is
es-AR. The AI uses it to frame and prioritize; it never changes computed numbers.
It travels in requests and responses, so it keeps one OpenAPI schema (no -Input/-Output split).
CreatorContext.title: CreatorContext

CreatorGoal.description: What the creator publishes for. es-AR labels live in the frontend.
CreatorGoal.title: CreatorGoal

Draft.description: A generated post draft in the creator's voice (es-AR).
Draft.title: Draft

DraftRequest.description: Ask for drafts for an already analyzed account, optionally based on a topic or a recommendation.
DraftRequest.title: DraftRequest

ErrorCode.description: Machine-readable error codes returned by the HTTP API.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

Evidence.description: A displayable data point backing an insight, e.g. label "Tasa de guardados", value "2,1% vs 0,8%".
Evidence.title: Evidence

FeatureFlags.description: Which optional features are enabled. The frontend hides disabled ones.
FeatureFlags.title: FeatureFlags

HealthResponse.description: Liveness response, including the contract version the backend implements.
HealthResponse.title: HealthResponse

Impact.description: Estimated impact of acting on an insight.
Impact.title: Impact

Insight.description: A pattern found in the account's data, explained in es-AR.
Insight.title: Insight

InsightCategory.description: What an insight or recommendation is about.
InsightCategory.title: InsightCategory

JobStatus.description: Lifecycle of an analysis job: queued -> fetching -> analyzing -> done | failed.
JobStatus.title: JobStatus

LengthBucket.description: Post length bucket. Thresholds live in eduhub_shared.metrics.length_bucket.
LengthBucket.title: LengthBucket

MediaType.description: Type of media attached to a post.
MediaType.title: MediaType

Persona.description: A synthetic audience member, sampled from real survey respondents (ENCC 2022-23 via OpenARG).
Persona.title: Persona

PersonaReaction.description: One persona's reaction to one variant.
PersonaReaction.title: PersonaReaction

Platform.description: Social platform a profile or post belongs to. Only X is implemented for the hackathon.
Platform.title: Platform

Post.description: A single post with its metrics, normalized independently of the data source.
Post.title: Post

PostFeatures.description: Features extracted from a post. Semantic fields (topic, tone, sentiment, hook, cta) may be None.

media_type.description: First media item; None = text only.

hook.description: How the post opens (label set defined by eduhub_ai).
hook.title: Hook

cta.description: What the post asks the reader to do (label set by eduhub_ai).
cta.title: Cta

PostFeatures.title: PostFeatures

PostKind.description: Kind of post: original, reply, quote or plain repost.
PostKind.title: PostKind

PostMetrics.description: Raw counters of a post. Private metrics are only available with the official API on own posts.

impressions.description: Views. None when the source does not provide them.
impressions.title: Impressions

PostMetrics.title: PostMetrics

PostRates.description: Rates of a post over impressions (see eduhub_shared.metrics). None when impressions are missing or zero.
PostRates.title: PostRates

PreferredCta.description: What the creator wants readers to do.
PreferredCta.title: PreferredCta

PublishRequest.description: Publish a text now, or schedule it when scheduled_for is set.
PublishRequest.title: PublishRequest

url.description: Published post URL, or compose URL when status is 'intent'.
url.title: Url

PublishStatus.description: Outcome of a publish request. INTENT means the user must confirm in X via the returned compose URL.
PublishStatus.title: PublishStatus

ReactionType.description: What a simulated persona does with a post. IGNORE and READ are passive.
ReactionType.title: ReactionType

Recommendation.description: A concrete action for the creator, in es-AR. Priority 1 is the most important.
Recommendation.title: Recommendation

SegmentDimension.description: Dimension used to group posts in segment stats.
SegmentDimension.title: SegmentDimension

SegmentReaction.description: Interaction rate of one audience segment for one variant.
SegmentReaction.title: SegmentReaction

SegmentStat.description: Performance of posts sharing a value of one dimension (e.g. topic = "ahorro").
SegmentStat.title: SegmentStat

SimulationRequest.description: Test 1-3 text variants against a synthetic audience.
SimulationRequest.title: SimulationRequest

SimulationResult.description: Result of a simulation. Orientative only: it compares variants, it does not predict real engagement.
SimulationResult.title: SimulationResult

TimeSlotStat.description: Performance of posts published in a weekday/hour slot (Argentina time).
TimeSlotStat.title: TimeSlotStat

Trend.description: A trending topic observed at a given time and location.
Trend.title: Trend

VariantResult.description: Aggregated reactions to one variant. interaction_rate = weighted share of active reactions.
VariantResult.title: VariantResult
